reason: The 1.2.0 candidate exposed a version-coupled negative fixture: its incompatible baseVersion was hard-coded to 1.2.0 and became compatible when the product reached 1.2.0. The authorized change derives an always-different major version while preserving the expected Bundle/review/base identity mismatch boundary.
